content.title: Foundations & Baseline Understanding: Parallel Parenting & Co-Parenting Safety Plans in DFV Recovery
content.overview: This section provides a trauma-informed, practical guide to understanding the core purpose of parallel parenting & co-parenting safety plans in dfv recovery and how it shapes physical, emotional, and relational safety in daily family life. Designed for survivor parents managing post-separation contact and court orders safely after DFV (Track 3 Master), it focuses on realistic, repeatable steps that strengthen safety, predictability, and connection.
content.psychoeducation: Why does parallel parenting & co-parenting safety plans in dfv recovery matter in section 1? Children and families thrive on predictability, nervous-system safety, and attuned repair. When parallel parenting & co-parenting safety plans in dfv recovery is practised consistently, stress responses decrease and relational trust grows. By focusing on understanding the core purpose of parallel parenting & co-parenting safety plans in dfv recovery and how it shapes physical, emotional, and relational safety in daily family life, caregivers and practitioners create a calmer, safer environment where children can regulate and develop confidence.
